dev_strongest_untrained.selection_rule: dev_selection_runs deterministic lexicographic order: max task_completion_exact, max task_completion_goal, min invalid_loop_rate_v2, min premature_abandonment, min false_success (evaluated strictly on dev eval24 prior to G4 unsealing)

p_vs_b3_error_sft.honest_interpretation: 纠错 SFT (`B3`) 在封闭测试集上显著优于动作级 DPO (`P`)（`P < B3`）；直接最大似然监督比离线偏好损失更稳健，不应宣称 DPO 训练目标优越（Proposal §8.2）。
